title: Power Automate: Desktop flow libraries
description: Power Automate will introduce desktop flow libraries, enabling makers to create and publish libraries with reusable automation building blocks (subflows) that can be used across multiple desktop flows. Makers can centralize commonly used automation logic in libraries and reuse it across their solutions, reducing duplication, simplifying maintenance, and promoting consistent automation practices.
